$schema_note: Test scenarios for the Devin-AutoGit CLI. Each scenario runs against a throwaway `git init` repo (with a local bare 'origin' remote unless stated otherwise). `autonomous` = true means the CLI is invoked with no TTY and Devin detection active (DEVIN_SESSION_ID set) so fail-closed defaults apply.

setup_steps: export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123
use empty HOME dir so no global config exists
scenarios.expected_behavior: detects Devin environment, writes global config
assertions: ~/.devin-autogit/config.json is created and is valid JSON
stderr mentions Devin environment detected
stdout is empty (informational output goes to stderr)

setup_steps: unset DEVIN_SESSION_ID and DEVIN_ID
no .devin/ directory, no /opt/.devin marker
run with a TTY (interactive)
scenarios.expected_behavior: detects generic environment, writes global config with interactive defaults
assertions: ~/.devin-autogit/config.json created
config records environment as generic/interactive
stderr prints instructions for wiring the ship step

setup_steps: run `devin-autogit setup` once successfully first
run it a second time
scenarios.expected_behavior: second run succeeds without corrupting existing config
assertions: ~/.devin-autogit/config.json still valid JSON after second run
user-modified settings in global config are preserved

setup_steps: git init repo with an initial commit
add local bare origin remote
scenarios.expected_behavior: enables auto-ship by writing .devin-autogit.json
assertions: .devin-autogit.json exists in repo root and is valid JSON
config validates against the Zod repo schema
`devin-autogit status` afterwards reports enabled=true

setup_steps: git init repo with initial commit and origin remote
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123
invoke with stdin/stdout not a TTY
scenarios.expected_behavior: enables repo with fail-closed policy defaults for agent invocations
assertions: .devin-autogit.json contains fail-closed defaults (protected branches include main and master, default deny globs present)
no interactive prompt is shown (command completes without stdin input)

setup_steps: git init repo with initial commit and origin remote
write custom-policy.json with { "protectedBranches": ["release"], "denyGlobs": ["secrets/**"] }
scenarios.expected_behavior: enables repo using the supplied policy file
assertions: .devin-autogit.json reflects protectedBranches=["release"] and denyGlobs including secrets/**

setup_steps: git init repo with initial commit
write bad-policy.json containing invalid JSON: `{ nope`
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuses to enable; configuration error
assertions: .devin-autogit.json is NOT created
stderr explains the policy file failed to parse/validate

setup_steps: git init repo with .devin-autogit.json present (previously enabled)
scenarios.expected_behavior: disables auto-ship
assertions: repo is no longer enabled (config removed or marked disabled)
`devin-autogit status` afterwards reports enabled=false
subsequent `devin-autogit ship` is a silent no-op with exit 0

setup_steps: git init repo with NO .devin-autogit.json
scenarios.expected_behavior: no-op; reports already disabled
assertions: exit code is 0
stderr notes the repo was not enabled

setup_steps: git init repo, enable via `devin-autogit on`
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123
scenarios.expected_behavior: prints machine-readable status on stdout
assertions: stdout parses as JSON
JSON includes version, enabled=true, devinSession detected with id devin-abc123, policy summary, heldChanges state, swarm branch info
no informational text on stdout besides the JSON

setup_steps: run in a temp directory that is NOT a git repo
scenarios.expected_behavior: configuration/user error: not a git repository
assertions: stderr says not inside a git repository
no stack trace is printed

setup_steps: git init repo with initial commit, valid .devin-autogit.json
add reachable local bare origin remote
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123
scenarios.expected_behavior: all diagnostics pass
assertions: stderr reports git ok, remote reachable, Devin env detected, config valid
exit code 0

setup_steps: git init repo, set origin to a nonexistent path (git remote add origin /nonexistent/bare.git)
write .devin-autogit.json containing invalid JSON
scenarios.expected_behavior: diagnostics report failures
assertions: stderr flags remote unreachable
stderr flags config invalid
exit code 1

setup_steps: git init repo with initial commit pushed to local bare origin
enable repo on branch devin/test/agent-1
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123 DEVIN_TASK='add feature x'
create src/feature.ts with benign content
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship
assertions: a new commit exists on HEAD containing src/feature.ts
commit body contains trailers Devin-Session: devin-abc123, Devin-Task, and Shipped-by: devin-autogit
origin branch devin/test/agent-1 points at the new commit
working tree is clean afterwards

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with origin
modify an existing tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship with user-provided subject
assertions: commit subject is exactly 'fix: adjust widget'
trailers still appended to the body
pushed to origin

setup_steps: enabled repo, working tree clean (no changes)
scenarios.expected_behavior: clean no-op
assertions: no new commit created
stderr notes nothing to ship
exit code 0 (never breaks the agent's turn)

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with a modified file
scenarios.expected_behavior: evaluates gates and reports what would ship without committing
assertions: no commit is created and nothing is pushed
stdout JSON includes decision (would-ship) and the file list
working tree changes remain intact

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with a benign new file
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship with golden machine-readable output
assertions: stdout parses as JSON
JSON contains result=shipped, commit sha, branch, pushed=true, files list
all human-readable logging is on stderr only

setup_steps: git init repo with a modified file, NO .devin-autogit.json
scenarios.expected_behavior: silent no-op (opt-in gate)
assertions: no commit created, nothing pushed
exit code 0
with --json, stdout JSON reports result=skipped reason=not-enabled

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1
create config.ts containing a realistic AWS access key line: aws_access_key_id = AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE plus a 40-char secret
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold
assertions: no commit created, nothing pushed
changes remain in the working tree (not discarded), everything unstaged
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=secrets with the offending file/pattern
stderr explains the secrets hit

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1
create .env file containing API_KEY=sk-live-realvalue1234567890
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold (sensitive filename)
assertions: no commit created
.env content untouched in working tree
hold reason cites the sensitive filename

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1
create .env.example containing API_KEY=your-key-here (placeholder in a template file)
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship (template-file exemption applies)
assertions: commit created and pushed including .env.example
no secrets hold triggered

setup_steps: enabled repo checked out on branch main (in default autonomous protected list)
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123, no TTY
modify a tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold (protected branch in autonomous mode)
assertions: no commit created, nothing pushed to main
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=protected-branch branch=main
changes remain in working tree

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with denyGlobs ["infra/**", "**/*.pem"]
create infra/prod.tf AND src/ok.ts in the same turn
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold (a denied staged path holds the whole ship)
assertions: no commit created — src/ok.ts is NOT shipped separately
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=path-policy with infra/prod.tf listed
both files remain in working tree

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with default size cap (300 files)
script-create 301 small new files
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold (file-count size cap)
assertions: no commit created
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=size-cap with counts
files remain in working tree

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with default 1 MB diff cap
create big.txt of 2 MB random-ish text
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold (byte size cap)
assertions: no commit created
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=size-cap
big.txt remains in working tree

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with llmGate enabled in config
unset any LLM API key env vars
modify a tracked file; autonomous (no TTY, DEVIN_SESSION_ID set)
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold (LLM gate unavailable, fail-closed)
assertions: no commit created, nothing pushed
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=llm-gate-unavailable
stderr notes the gate could not run

setup_steps: enabled repo with llmGate enabled, API endpoint pointed at a local server that never responds (or sleeps past the timeout)
modify a tracked file; autonomous mode
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold (LLM gate timeout, fail-closed)
assertions: no commit created
result=held reason includes timeout/unavailable
secrets scan ran BEFORE the diff would have been sent (verify via ordering in logs)

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1
create file with a real-looking GitHub token ghp_ followed by 36 alphanumerics
autonomous mode: DEVIN_SESSION_ID set, no TTY
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold — --force-secrets refused in autonomous mode
assertions: no commit created despite --force-secrets
stdout JSON reports the override was refused (human TTY required)
changes remain in working tree

setup_steps: trigger a hold (e.g. size cap) with `devin-autogit ship` once
raise the size cap in .devin-autogit.json
run `devin-autogit ship` again
scenarios.expected_behavior: held changes are re-staged and shipped on the next ship once gates pass
assertions: second ship creates one commit containing the previously held files
pushed to origin

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1; run a successful `devin-autogit ship` (commit has Shipped-by: devin-autogit trailer)
remote origin branch points at the shipped commit
scenarios.expected_behavior: remote rewind (force-with-lease to parent) then local mixed reset
assertions: origin branch now points at the shipped commit's parent
local HEAD points at the parent
the shipped files are back in the working tree as uncommitted changes (mixed reset)

setup_steps: enabled repo; make a manual commit with plain `git commit` (no devin-autogit trailers) and push
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse — last commit was not made by devin-autogit
assertions: no reset performed, HEAD unchanged
origin unchanged
stderr explains the last commit lacks the Shipped-by: devin-autogit trailer

setup_steps: ship a commit with devin-autogit
simulate another agent: clone origin elsewhere, add a new commit on top, push
run undo in the original checkout
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse — remote has moved past the shipped commit
assertions: origin history untouched (newer commit still present)
local HEAD unchanged
stderr explains the remote advanced beyond the shipped commit

setup_steps: enabled repo with only the initial (non-autogit) commit
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse — no devin-autogit commit to undo
assertions: no git state changed
stderr says nothing to undo

setup_steps: enabled repo with at least one commit
scenarios.expected_behavior: creates a namespaced checkpoint ref
assertions: a ref matching refs/devin-autogit/checkpoints/<ts> exists (git for-each-ref)
the ref points at current HEAD
label 'before-refactor' recorded (in ref name or annotation)
reflog untouched by checkpoint creation

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1 with a benign modified file
scenarios.expected_behavior: auto-checkpoints pre-ship state, then ships
assertions: a checkpoint ref exists pointing at the pre-ship HEAD (the new commit's parent)
the ship commit exists and is pushed
checkpoint ref created before the push (pre-push state recoverable)

setup_steps: create checkpoint, make a new commit, create a second checkpoint
scenarios.expected_behavior: checkpoints accumulate under distinct timestamped refs
assertions: two distinct refs under refs/devin-autogit/checkpoints/
each points at the HEAD at time of creation

setup_steps: enabled repo with initial commit and origin remote
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123
scenarios.expected_behavior: creates 3 per-subagent worktrees and branches
assertions: 3 worktrees exist (git worktree list)
branches named devin/devin-abc123/agent-1..agent-3 exist
each worktree contains its own .devin-autogit.json (pre-enabled)
busy markers are isolated per worktree (marker dir resolves under each worktree's git dir)

setup_steps: run swarm init with 2 agents
in worktree 1: create fileA.ts and ship; in worktree 2: create fileB.ts and ship (non-overlapping changes)
scenarios.expected_behavior: merges/rebases both subagent branches into integration branch
assertions: integration branch contains fileA.ts and fileB.ts
both subagent commits (with their trailers) reachable from integration
no merge conflict markers in any file

setup_steps: run swarm init with 2 agents
both worktrees modify the SAME lines of shared.ts differently and ship
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold — fail-closed on merge conflict, no partial integration
assertions: integration branch is left without conflict markers (merge aborted or never committed)
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=conflict naming the conflicting branch/files
subagent branches untouched

setup_steps: swarm init with 3 agents; agents 1 and 3 ship non-conflicting work, agent 2 shipped nothing (branch equals base)
scenarios.expected_behavior: collects branches with work, skips empty branches
assertions: integration contains agent-1 and agent-3 changes
empty agent-2 branch skipped without error

setup_steps: git repo without a .devin/ directory
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-xyz789
scenarios.expected_behavior: Devin session detected via env var
assertions: status JSON reports devin.detected=true, source=env, sessionId=devin-xyz789

setup_steps: git repo containing an empty .devin/ directory
unset all DEVIN_* env vars
scenarios.expected_behavior: Devin session detected via .devin/ directory
assertions: status JSON reports devin.detected=true, source=dot-devin-dir

setup_steps: git repo with no .devin/, no DEVIN_* env vars, no VM markers
scenarios.expected_behavior: no Devin session detected; interactive defaults
assertions: status JSON reports devin.detected=false
effective mode is interactive (not fail-closed autonomous)

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/sess/agent-1
write .devin/blueprint.yaml with repo conventions: protected_branches: [main, release/*], branch_prefix: devin/
modify a tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: blueprint conventions merged into effective config; ship proceeds on allowed branch
assertions: status/ship JSON shows effective protected branches include release/* from blueprint
ship succeeds because current branch matches allowed prefix

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/sess/agent-1
unset DEVIN_* env vars
write .devin/session.json: { "sessionId": "devin-fromfile", "task": "Implement login form" }
modify a tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: session ID and task read from session.json drive commit subject and trailers
assertions: commit subject derived from 'Implement login form' (72-char capped)
trailer Devin-Session: devin-fromfile present
trailer Devin-Task present with a slug of the task

setup_steps: enabled repo; write .devin/blueprint.yaml with malformed YAML (e.g. unclosed bracket)
modify a tracked file; autonomous mode
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold — metadata unparseable is uncertainty; fail closed in autonomous mode
assertions: no commit created
stdout JSON reports result=held reason mentioning invalid metadata
changes remain in working tree

setup_steps: enabled repo on devin/test/agent-1
export DEVIN_SESSION_ID=devin-abc123 DEVIN_TASK='Fix the flaky retry logic in HTTP client'
modify a tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship with correctly formatted trailers
assertions: `git log -1 --format=%B` ends with a trailer block separated from the body by a blank line
`git interpret-trailers --parse` extracts Devin-Session, Devin-Task, Shipped-by keys
Devin-Session value is devin-abc123
Shipped-by value is devin-autogit
Devin-Task value is a short slug of the task

setup_steps: ship a commit whose message body itself contains the literal text 'Shipped-by: devin-autogit' in a code block within the subject/body (crafted via -m)
then make a plain manual git commit on top
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse — trailer parsing must use real trailer semantics, not substring match
assertions: undo refuses because HEAD (the manual commit) has no genuine trailer
no git state changed

setup_steps: enabled repo, DEVIN_TASK set to a 200-character sentence with newlines
modify a tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: subject flattened and capped at 72 chars
assertions: commit subject length <= 72
subject contains no newline characters
full trailers intact in body

setup_steps: enabled repo A on devin/test/agent-1 pushed to bare origin
clone origin to repo B, commit a non-conflicting change to the same branch, push from B
in repo A: modify a different file, run ship (push will initially be rejected non-fast-forward)
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship — fetch, rebase onto updated remote, retry push
assertions: origin branch contains BOTH repo B's commit and repo A's new commit
repo A's commit is rebased on top (linear history, no merge commit)
exit code 0

setup_steps: same as nff-001 but repo B's pushed commit modifies the SAME lines repo A changed
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold — rebase conflict cannot be auto-resolved, fail closed
assertions: rebase aborted; repo A left in a non-conflicted state with local changes preserved
nothing force-pushed to origin
stdout JSON reports result=held reason=rebase-conflict

setup_steps: enabled repo checked out on main
DEVIN_SESSION_ID set, stdin/stdout are NOT a TTY
modify a tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold — autonomous mode protects main by default
assertions: JSON reports mode=autonomous
result=held reason=protected-branch

setup_steps: enabled repo checked out on main, config does NOT list main as protected for interactive use
no DEVIN_* env vars, run under a PTY (interactive)
modify a tracked file
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship — interactive human defaults are not autonomous-protected
assertions: commit created and pushed to main
status/ship reports mode=interactive

setup_steps: enabled repo on a feature branch, no Devin detection, run under a PTY
create a file with a placeholder-looking but flagged token
scenarios.expected_behavior: ship — a human at a TTY may override the secrets gate
assertions: commit created and pushed despite the secrets flag
stderr warns that the secrets gate was overridden

setup_steps: enabled repo whose .devin-autogit.json sets maxFiles=300
create 6 new files
scenarios.expected_behavior: hold — env override (env > repo > global > defaults) lowers the cap to 5
assertions: result=held reason=size-cap
JSON shows effective maxFiles=5
